import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static final int N = 10;
    static String[] g = new String[N];
    static int[][] n_scientists = new int[N][N];
    static int[][] n_rescue = new int[N][N];
    static int[][] infect_time = new int[N][N];
    static int[][][][] reach_time = new int[N][N][N][N];
    static final int[] di = {-1, 1, 0, 0};
    static final int[] dj = {0, 0, -1, 1};
    static final int FLOW_N = 2 * N * N + 2;
    static final int INF = 1_000_000_000;
    static List<Integer>[] adj = new ArrayList[FLOW_N + 1];
    static int[][] c = new int[FLOW_N + 1][FLOW_N + 1];
    static int[][] f = new int[FLOW_N + 1][FLOW_N + 1];
    static int[] adj_ptr = new int[FLOW_N + 1];
    static int[] d = new int[FLOW_N + 1];
    static int[] p = new int[FLOW_N + 1];

    static boolean make_level_graph(int s, int t) {
        Arrays.fill(d, -1);
        d[s] = 0;
        Queue<Integer> q = new LinkedList<>();
        q.offer(s);
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int u = q.poll();
            for (int v : adj[u]) {
                if (c[u][v] - f[u][v] > 0 && d[v] == -1) {
                    d[v] = d[u] + 1;
                    q.offer(v);
                }
            }
        }
        return d[t] != -1;
    }

    static boolean dfs(int u, int t) {
        if (u == t) return true;
        for (int i = adj_ptr[u]; i < adj[u].size(); i++) {
            adj_ptr[u] = i;
            int v = adj[u].get(i);
            if (d[v] == d[u] + 1 && c[u][v] - f[u][v] > 0 && dfs(v, t)) {
                p[v] = u;
                return true;
            }
        }
        return false;
    }

    static boolean find_aug_path(int s, int t) {
        Arrays.fill(p, -1);
        p[s] = 0;
        return dfs(s, t);
    }

    static void init_flow() {
        for (int i = 0; i <= FLOW_N; i++) {
            Arrays.fill(c[i], 0);
            Arrays.fill(f[i], 0);
        }
    }

    static void add_edge(int u, int v, int capacity) {
        adj[u].add(v);
        adj[v].add(u);
        c[u][v] += capacity;
    }

    static int max_flow(int s, int t) {
        int max_flow_value = 0;
        while (make_level_graph(s, t)) {
            Arrays.fill(adj_ptr, 0);
            while (find_aug_path(s, t)) {
                int b = INF;
                for (int v = t, u = p[v]; v != s; v = u, u = p[v]) {
                    b = Math.min(b, c[u][v] - f[u][v]);
                }
                for (int v = t, u = p[v]; v != s; v = u, u = p[v]) {
                    f[u][v] += b;
                    f[v][u] -= b;
                }
                max_flow_value += b;
            }
        }
        return max_flow_value;
    }

    static int node(int n, int i, int j, boolean right) {
        return i * n + j + (right ? n * n : 0);
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        String[] firstLine = br.readLine().split(" ");
        int n = Integer.parseInt(firstLine[0]);
        int t = Integer.parseInt(firstLine[1]);
        
        for (int i = 0; i <= FLOW_N; i++) {
            adj[i] = new ArrayList<>();
        }
        
        String[] lines = new String[n];
        int[] explodeI = new int[1];
        int[] explodeJ = new int[1];
        
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            lines[i] = br.readLine();
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                char ch = lines[i].charAt(j);
                if (ch == 'Y') {
                    g[i] = (g[i] == null) ? "" : g[i];
                    g[i] += 'Y';
                } else if (ch == 'Z') {
                    g[i] = (g[i] == null) ? "" : g[i];
                    g[i] += 'Z';
                    explodeI[0] = i;
                    explodeJ[0] = j;
                } else {
                    g[i] = (g[i] == null) ? "" : g[i];
                    g[i] += '.';
                    n_scientists[i][j] += ch - '0';
                }
            }
        }
        
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            String line = br.readLine();
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                char ch = line.charAt(j);
                if (ch != 'Y' && ch != 'Z') {
                    n_rescue[i][j] += ch - '0';
                }
            }
        }
        
        for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < N; j++) {
                infect_time[i][j] = -1;
            }
        }
        infect_time[explodeI[0]][explodeJ[0]] = 0;
        Queue<int[]> q = new LinkedList<>();
        q.offer(new int[]{explodeI[0], explodeJ[0]});
        
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int[] cell = q.poll();
            int i = cell[0], j = cell[1];
            for (int d = 0; d < 4; d++) {
                int ni = i + di[d], nj = j + dj[d];
                if (0 <= ni && ni < n && 0 <= nj && nj < n && 
                    (g[ni].charAt(nj) == '.') && infect_time[ni][nj] == -1) {
                    infect_time[ni][nj] = infect_time[i][j] + 1;
                    q.offer(new int[]{ni, nj});
                }
            }
        }
        
        for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < N; j++) {
                for (int ii = 0; ii < N; ii++) {
                    for (int jj = 0; jj < N; jj++) {
                        reach_time[i][j][ii][jj] = -1;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (g[i].charAt(j) == '.') {
                    reach_time[i][j][i][j] = 0;
                    Queue<int[]> queue = new LinkedList<>();
                    queue.offer(new int[]{i, j});
                    while (!queue.isEmpty()) {
                        int[] cell = queue.poll();
                        int ii = cell[0], jj = cell[1];
                        if (infect_time[ii][jj] == -1 || reach_time[i][j][ii][jj] < infect_time[ii][jj]) {
                            for (int dd = 0; dd < 4; dd++) {
                                int ni = ii + di[dd], nj = jj + dj[dd];
                                if (0 <= ni && ni < n && 0 <= nj && nj < n && 
                                    g[ni].charAt(nj) == '.' &&
                                    (infect_time[ni][nj] == -1 || reach_time[i][j][ii][jj] + 1 <= infect_time[ni][nj]) &&
                                    reach_time[i][j][ni][nj] == -1) {
                                    reach_time[i][j][ni][nj] = reach_time[i][j][ii][jj] + 1;
                                    queue.offer(new int[]{ni, nj});
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        
        int src = 2 * n * n;
        int sink = 2 * n * n + 1;
        init_flow();
        
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (n_scientists[i][j] > 0) {
                    add_edge(src, node(n, i, j, false), n_scientists[i][j]);
                }
                if (n_rescue[i][j] > 0) {
                    add_edge(node(n, i, j, true), sink, n_rescue[i][j]);
                }
                for (int ii = 0; ii < n; ii++) {
                    for (int jj = 0; jj < n; jj++) {
                        if (reach_time[i][j][ii][jj] != -1 && reach_time[i][j][ii][jj] <= t) {
                            add_edge(node(n, i, j, false), node(n, ii, jj, true), INF);
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        
        System.out.println(max_flow(src, sink));
    }
}
